title: Awesome AI Architect
tagline: A self-updating map of the GenAI engineering stack: agents, RAG, MCP, evals, LLMOps and AI security. Classified automatically from the GitHub stars and open-source work of an AI architect.

categories.title: MCP & Tool Use
categories.blurb: Model Context Protocol servers, clients, gateways and function-calling infrastructure.

categories.title: Agent Memory & Persistent Context

categories.title: RAG, Retrieval & Knowledge
categories.blurb: Retrieval-augmented generation, vector search, document parsing, embeddings and knowledge graphs.

categories.title: Evaluation, Benchmarks & Testing

categories.title: Observability, LLMOps & FinOps

categories.title: AI Security, Safety & Governance

categories.title: Generative Search, GEO & LLMO

categories.title: Prompt & Context Engineering
categories.blurb: Prompt design and optimization, context engineering, structured outputs and instruction profiling.

categories.title: AI Coding Agents & Skills
categories.blurb: Coding agents, IDE copilots, agent skills, plugins and harness tooling for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and peers.

categories.title: Agent Frameworks & Orchestration
categories.blurb: Frameworks and runtimes for single and multi-agent systems, planning, memory and orchestration.

categories.title: Inference, Serving & Model Routing
categories.blurb: Local and production inference engines, quantization, AI gateways and model routers.

categories.title: Models, Training & Fine-tuning
categories.blurb: Foundation models, fine-tuning, distillation, reinforcement learning, datasets and ML frameworks.

categories.title: Vision, Voice & Generative Media
categories.blurb: Speech, text-to-speech, OCR, computer vision, image and video generation and multimodal models.

categories.title: Data Engineering, Scraping & Analytics
categories.blurb: Pipelines, web crawling for LLMs, text-to-SQL, warehouses and analytics tooling.

categories.title: Automation, Browser Agents & Productivity
categories.blurb: Workflow automation, browser and computer-use agents, extensions and everyday productivity tools.

categories.title: Frontend, Design & Generative UI
categories.blurb: Design systems, UI components, design taste for AI agents and generative interfaces.

categories.title: Cloud, DevOps & Infrastructure
categories.blurb: Deployment, containers, CI/CD and cloud infrastructure for shipping AI systems.

categories.title: AI Apps & Chat Interfaces
categories.blurb: End-user AI applications, chat UIs, assistants and business tools built on LLMs.

categories.title: Learning, Papers & Awesome Lists

categories.title: To Triage
